topic: Reactance, impedance and resonance (G5A; 12 pool questions)

questions.question: What happens when inductive and capacitive reactance are equal in a series LC circuit?

choices.A: Resonance causes impedance to be very high
choices.B: Impedance is equal to the geometric mean of the inductance and capacitance
choices.C: Resonance causes impedance to be very low
choices.D: Impedance is equal to the arithmetic mean of the inductance and capacitance

questions.answer: Resonance causes impedance to be very low

questions.question: What is reactance?

choices.A: Opposition to the flow of direct current caused by resistance
choices.B: Opposition to the flow of alternating current caused by capacitance or inductance
choices.C: Reinforcement of the flow of direct current caused by resistance
choices.D: Reinforcement of the flow of alternating current caused by capacitance or inductance

questions.answer: Opposition to the flow of alternating current caused by capacitance or inductance

questions.question: Which of the following is opposition to the flow of alternating current in an inductor?
Which of the following is opposition to the flow of alternating current in a capacitor?
How does an inductor react to AC?

choices.A: As the frequency of the applied AC increases, the reactance decreases
choices.B: As the amplitude of the applied AC increases, the reactance increases
choices.C: As the amplitude of the applied AC increases, the reactance decreases
choices.D: As the frequency of the applied AC increases, the reactance increases

questions.answer: As the frequency of the applied AC increases, the reactance increases

questions.question: How does a capacitor react to AC?

choices.A: As the frequency of the applied AC increases, the reactance decreases
choices.B: As the frequency of the applied AC increases, the reactance increases
choices.C: As the amplitude of the applied AC increases, the reactance increases
choices.D: As the amplitude of the applied AC increases, the reactance decreases

questions.answer: As the frequency of the applied AC increases, the reactance decreases

questions.question: What is the term for the inverse of impedance?
What is impedance?

choices.A: The ratio of current to voltage
choices.B: The product of current and voltage
choices.C: The ratio of voltage to current
choices.D: The product of current and reactance

questions.answer: The ratio of voltage to current

questions.question: What unit is used to measure reactance?

What occurs in an LC circuit at resonance?

choices.D: Inductive reactance and capacitive reactance cancel
